title: Physics-Templated Symbolic Regression discovers closed-form, differentiable equations for high-entropy alloy properties
description:
Code and data for the PT-SR framework: a two-stage symbolic regression in which a composition function is fitted at a single temperature and a temperature function is then fitted to the residual ratios under one of nine physics-motivated templates, with BIC selecting among them.

Contains the search and the nine templates, the nine published baselines re-trained on this corpus, the leave-one-dataset-out experiment over six cross-source folds, the inverse-design optimisation, the 684-point CoCrCuFeNi molecular-dynamics corpus, and all 660 discovered equations.
